purpose: Operational ranking priors only until enough observed outcomes exist.
rules: Operational priors MUST NOT be presented as empirically calibrated probabilities.
Weighted pipeline MUST remain null unless both monetary value and calibrated_probability_pct have defensible evidence.
Recompute empirical stage conversion from closed outcomes only.
Keep segment-level models separate when sample size permits: Italy agencies, Spain agencies, EU projects, local-no-website.
Never raise probability merely because a lead has a high subjective Revenue Priority score.
